tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Menu foundation and the ground under every screen shell. Candidate value from design-system.md.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Opaque panels, dialogs, settings rows, inventory slots.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and selected surface for rows, tabs, list items.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: translucent backing for HUD groups and dialog backdrops over the 3D world. Keep text on scrim at text-primary only.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and panel boundaries. 2.5:1 on background, 2.3:1 on surface: decorative separation only, never the sole outline of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: outlines of inputs, sliders, switches and empty inventory slots. 3.6:1 on surface, 3.4:1 on surface-raised, meeting the 3:1 non-text floor that border misses.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Main text on background, surface, surface-raised and scrim.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text, help text, inactive tab labels on background and surface (9:1+).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: labels of disabled controls on surface. Always pair with a disabled state shape, not color alone.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Pale lime. Primary actions, selected markers, active tab underline, progress fill. Brand and action color; never used for shields.

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills (primary button label).

tokens.name: health
tokens.usage: Health meter fill and health-item cue (Field Patch, Trauma Kit). Always paired with a numeric value.

tokens.name: shield
tokens.usage: Shield meter fill and shield-item cue (Shield Cell, Pack, Core). Cyan belongs to shields only.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved and connected feedback. Close in lightness to danger (1.7:1): always carry a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution: storm closing, low ammo, unsaved binding conflict.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Damage, errors, destructive actions (Leave match, Reset category). Near health in hue: errors always carry an icon and text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard/controller focus ring, offset 2px, on every surface. Distinct from accent selection.

tokens.name: storm
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: ion storm boundary on map and minimap, storm timer. Violet is environmental; never a control color.

tokens.name: colony-amber
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: warm colony equipment lights in illustration and loading art. Not a UI state color.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: Main menu and results headline. Archivo at width 125 (expanded). One per screen.

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: Section headings inside a screen; dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 59 bots will fill the remaining places.
styles.usage: Running text, dialog body, lobby info.

styles.name: supporting
styles.sample: Applies immediately. Saved on this device.
styles.usage: Help text under setting rows, item descriptions, keycaps. The smallest text size in the system.

styles.name: hud-number
styles.usage: Health, shields, ammo, survivor count. Tabular numerals on.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, meter segment gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inventory slots, keycap padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside small controls, stacked label/value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding, gap between related controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between HUD groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, gap between settings sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Screen safe-area inset at 1920x1080; HUD safe area default.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Separation between major screen regions.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, selects, tabs, text inputs.

tokens.name: primary-height
tokens.usage: The one primary action per region (Play, Start match).

tokens.name: row-min-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a SettingRow.

tokens.name: slot-size
tokens.usage: Intentional addition: square inventory slot at 1920x1080, scales with HUD scale.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus ring stroke and offset.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, keycaps, inventory slots, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Necessary panels and dialogs only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Switch track and thumb, slider thumb.
